data.narrative:
Curio Solutions is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Ed McGinnis and Pete Zweifel that has raised $16M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 total companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms in the nuclear energy sector at similar or adjacent stages, including Fuse Energy, Valar Atomics, Nano Nuclear Energy, Oklo, and X-Energy.

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement to the $16M total raised proxy, yielding $32M. Peer-median valuation across the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Valar Atomics at $6.0B Series B, Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M Seed, and Fuse Energy at $200M Series A) produces a median of $808M, with a range spanning $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $27M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $420M. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and maturity variance within the peer set, particularly the 30x gap between the Seed-stage and Series B comparables. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation relative to peers, path to near-term revenue, and capital efficiency to subsequent funding milestones. Stage-progression alone understates market precedent; peer-median better reflects investor appetite in this sector but masks idiosyncratic risk.
